#### Time (plain build, PR and base taking turns)

No case got slower or faster beyond noise (11 cases, 5 turns each).

<details><summary>Times</summary>

| Case | p50 | p99 | ops/s | CPU/op |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze: fold a render’s CPU profile into the report` | ≈ 2.13–2.21 ms → 2.15–2.30 ms | ≈ 3.99–4.85 ms → 4.22–5.21 ms | ≈ 409/s–436/s → 409/s–435/s | ≈ 3.45–8.87 ms → 3.87–6.85 ms |
| `decode_mappings: a server chunk’s source map` | ≈ 726.29–796.34 µs → 723.80–791.03 µs | ≈ 1.14–2.06 ms → 1.14–2.60 ms | ≈ 1,213/s–1,308/s → 1,154/s–1,315/s | ≈ 876.83 µs–1.13 ms → 961.67 µs–1.39 ms |

| `doc_diff: two renders of a page that differ in a few rows` | ≈ 404.84–415.90 µs → 407.94–411.52 µs | ≈ 917.20–959.26 µs → 916.47–965.42 µs | ≈ 2,134/s–2,320/s → 2,220/s–2,313/s | ≈ 451.09–934.92 µs → 490.14–666.04 µs |
| `attribute_gc: what each pause of a window was charged to, as the window grows` | ≈ 431.42–448.80 µs → 433.71–443.90 µs | ≈ 890.37 µs–1.22 ms → 852.44 µs–1.05 ms | ≈ 2,077/s–2,202/s → 2,123/s–2,195/s | ≈ 610.01–882.20 µs → 631.05–774.51 µs |
| `attribute_gc: what each pause was charged to, as the window and its allocation reads grow` | ≈ 464.84–470.78 µs → 464.66–470.42 µs | ≈ 870.27 µs–1.05 ms → 863.53 µs–1.09 ms | ≈ 2,019/s–2,067/s → 1,981/s–2,067/s | ≈ 649.27–972.78 µs → 606.75–896.45 µs |
